reviewFindings.finding: preserveLastGood previously reused lastGood.nodes verbatim. A node that had transitionMotion=true in the accepted frame therefore remained true inside a later interrupted frame while frame.transitionMotionAllowed=false. The source contract contradicted itself and a renderer consulting node-level motion could animate preserved contact during failure.
reviewFindings.repair: Re-materialize preserved nodes with identical semantic/touch/TalkBack fields and transitionMotion=false; regression source now asserts semantic checkpoint equality instead of Java object identity.

reviewFindings.finding: Pulse identity could be reused with different visible contact semantics, weakening checkpoint/idempotence meaning.
reviewFindings.repair: Same visible pulseId is now accepted only when HeartbeatFrameCheckpoint.sameVisibleContact is exact; semantic collision fails closed with an explicit boundary.

reviewFindings.finding: The first motion-clamp DOM specimen targeted a .token animation selector that no rendered element actually used.
reviewFindings.repair: The selector now targets the real .light strong nodes; reduced-motion uses the same real selector.
